caption:
📖 Never put a colon after such as

A colon after "such as" is one of the easiest points to lose.

✅ A colon can't cut a sentence mid-thought.
✅ Wrong: The menu includes: tacos and soup.
✅ Right: The menu includes tacos and soup.
✅ Wrong: Try fruits such as: kiwi and figs.
✅ Right: Try fruits such as kiwi and figs.
✅ Right: The menu has two items: tacos and soup.

Save this for test day 🔖
